aboutGame.title: What is Mad King Redemption?
paragraphs: Mad King Redemption is a side-scrolling beat 'em up with roguelite elements from developer SECRET MISSION. The kingdom has fallen to the Mad King, who used forbidden magic to try to revive the queen and lost his sanity in the process. You fight through hordes of enemies using brawler-style combat, and between runs you upgrade heroes and unlock multiple skills.

The game combines old-school controls and a retro feel with 3D mechanics. The verified Steam page describes deep roguelite elements, hero upgrades and a growing set of skills, but it does not publish a complete hero list, skill tree, boss list or exact damage values. Our guides stick to what is documented and focus on practical, system-level advice.

modules.name: Mad King Redemption Wiki Beginner Guide
modules.description: A step-by-step introduction to your first hours: old-school controls, brawler combat, upgrade spending and the early mistakes that stall new players.

highlights.detail: Get familiar with movement, basic attacks and the controller or keyboard setup before your first real fight.
Read the tutorial prompts: they introduce the core beat 'em up controls and early roguelite systems.
Spend early upgrade resources on a focused damage or defensive path instead of spreading them everywhere.
Practice spacing and punishes; stop attacking when an enemy winds up a heavy hit.
Keep a healing option in reserve and create distance before you use it.
Clear optional fights while healthy to bank resources and experience before a boss room.

modules.name: Mad King Redemption Wiki Boss Guide
modules.description: A phase-by-phase approach to boss strategy covering preparation, attack patterns and role assignments. Specific boss names and redemption windows are not documented on the Steam page.

highlights.detail: Run a preparation checklist: consumables, defensive skills and cooldowns ready.
Phase 1 teaches the moveset; learn tells and hold your cooldowns.
Phase 2 may layer add waves and area denial; assign one caller for movement.
Phase 3 opens the redemption window; commit together and execute the action.
Final Stand peaks in density; survive first and deal damage second.
Reset after the window closes; the boss often retaliates in the first seconds.
